name: Okama Kenpo
description: Dance-kicks and stance changes, from the Kamabakka Kingdom: only an invitation opens it.

stages.name: Dance stances
stages.description: Ballet stances that are also guards.
stages.text: You took a ballet stance, and it was a fighting stance too.

stages.name: Ballet kicks
stages.text: You spun on one toe and kicked a man off his feet.

stages.name: Impossible angles
stages.description: Kicks that come from where no kick can.
stages.text: Your kick came from an angle nobody could have guarded.
